description: 1- and 3-phase power network meter with harmonics, 15/30/60 min mean power, relay and analogue outputs, Modbus RTU over RS485

sources.title: ND20 power network meter user manual
sources.note: section 8 (RS-485 interface, tables 9-12); program version 1.09 is the newest one the manual mentions

source: Lumel, ND20 power network meter user manual, section 8
notes: Measurements are read from the 7000 area: IEEE 754 floats in two registers, bytes in the order 3-2-1-0. The same data is available as 32-bit registers (7500-7786, one address per value) and in the byte order 1-0-3-2 (6000-6573); this map uses the 7000 and 7800 areas.
Values the meter cannot give are returned as 1e20 (above range or error) or -1e20 (below range).
Which values exist depends on the measurement mode (3Ph/4W, 3Ph/3W or 1Ph/2W). The manual has a column per mode; for 3Ph/3W the per-phase powers, voltages and power factors are not available.
Energy is also in registers 4038-4049 as 32-bit integers in units of 100 Wh. The meter returns 1e20 when it cannot give a value; the manual does not say how the integer energy registers behave.
Registers 1000-1077 hold the mean power archive (a window of 15 records); they are not listed here.
Registers marked with firmware_min 1.09 exist from program version 1.09. Registers 4062-4068 are reserved.
